payload.title: Authenticate Case0003 implementation trace and declared report inputs in versioned future analysis
payload.summary: P2 historical analysis integrity, not a demonstrated worker vulnerability. experiments/codex_dogfood/case_0003/analyze.py:join returns agent telemetry from codex_trace.jsonl but never compares its bytes with post_run.implementation_trace_sha256. Independent entirely authored packet: replacing a completed trace with an incomplete foreign.py open leaves all checked pins and post_run unchanged, yet join succeeds and emits the new telemetry. Original retained actual trace matches its post_run pin; no historical corruption established.
payload.benefit: Preserve frozen implementation. Add a versioned read-only future-analysis verifier for explicitly supported original schema: bind actual implementation trace to its independent post_run pin before interpreting events; authenticate declared patch/validation-log/report input closure where retained anchors exist, and reject unavailable/unsupported formats rather than reconstruct evidence. Acceptance: changed/truncated/substituted trace with unchanged pin refuses, correct retained bytes pass, encoding changes require correct original byte identity, missing/foreign pins refuse, no original receipt/output mutation. Test genuine trace-to-result association separately from neutral judgment materialization. Existing Graph3 partial-report and Increment23 neutral-binding bugs remain separate.
payload.uncertainty: Synthetic exploitability only. Direct digest inspection confirms the original Case3 trace is unchanged. An original hash is not semantic truth or proof every task obligation was authored. Suitable bounded maintenance/verifier implementation after authorization.
